highlights.title: The Takeaway: UN General Assembly debate Day 2
highlights.summary: This edition of UN News's The Takeaway recaps key highlghts at the UN General Assembly on Wednesday, including focus on the war in Ukraine and a renewed push by African countries for Security Council reform.

highlights.title: China e EUA prorrogam trégua comercial até janeiro
highlights.summary: Secretário do Tesouro norte-americano afirmou que o acordo, que deveria expirar em novembro, será ampliado até 10 de janeiro

highlights.title: Pope's visit to France 'an important moment for the Vatican'
highlights.summary: France is gearing up for the arrival of Pope Leo XIV in what will be the first state visit to the country by a pontiff since 2008. Seema Gupta, France 24's correspondent in Rome takes a look at the visit from the Vatican's point of view.

highlights.title: Families Urge Trump to Press Xi to Free Americans Detained in China
highlights.summary: The Americans being held in China are U Min Zin, a scholar who studied Myanmar, and Youlin Chen, a seismologist who researched North Korean nuclear tests.

highlights.title: Fears of flooding, landslides as Hurricane Polo churns off Mexico coast
highlights.summary: Residents of Mexico's Pacific beach towns were preparing for heavy rain and dangerous surf ​on Wednesday ‌as Hurricane Polo, a powerful Category 4 storm, tracked northwestward just ⁠offshore, threatening flooding and mudslides along the country's southwestern coast.

highlights.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula voltam a empatar no 2º turno no Agregador de Pesquisas para presidente da BBC News Brasil
highlights.summary: Acompanhe as últimas estimativas de intenção de voto para Lula x Flávio na eleição presidencial de 2026 reunidas no agregador de pesquisas eleitorais da BBC News Brasil.
